system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You have grown. Through your choices, decisions, faults and failures. You have survived countless fights, and have learned from them the righteous way to forge your own path. You develop another way to build Drive, select one between Teamwork and Mobility. Regardless of this choice, you also gain 2 additional ways to spend your Drive.

Build Drive

Teamwork. Once per turn, when an allied creature provides you a boost to a roll you make, cleanse you of a condition, restores your hit points or chakra point, or uses an effect that provides you advantage or any other form of assistance in combat, you gain 2 Drive. Other supportive effects can trigger this at GM’s discretion such as them interposing an attack or interrupting a harmful jutsu.

Mobility. Once per turn, when you transition to using a form of special movement such as Wall or Water Walking, Swimming, Climbing or Burrowing, before making an attack or casting a jutsu on the same turn, you gain 1 Drive.

Spend Drive

Battle Insight. You can study a hostile creature you can see within 60 feet of you, using your accumulated battle experience to gather information normally invisible to you. By spending 1 Drive, and a Bonus action, you gain one of the following pieces of information.

One random Damage or Condition immunity, resistance or vulnerability they have.

Their DR.

Their Highest Saving throw, and its bonus.

Their highest Jutsu attack Bonus and Save DC.

One special action or ability they have.

Recover. You can spend Drive in multiples of 2, up to your remaining. For every 2 Drive spent this way, you remove 1 rank of any Physical, Sensory or Mental condition currently affecting you.
